title: Explained | Why NMC is phasing out PG diploma medical courses from 2027
summary: The National Medical Commission has directed medical colleges offering PG diploma courses to apply for conversion of those seats into MD/MS broad-specialty degree seats; this move is the culmination of a policy shift that has been under way for nearly two decades
title_hi: NMC Decision : PG Diploma Courses Replaced by MD , MS Degrees
